_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistic (0-of-66) makes HOLD the skilled default; a directional claim requires seeing the breaker, and neither ETF flows nor funding has confirmed one yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst says HOLD (0.35 conf), narrative implies UP (0.75 conf); judge sides with analyst per trust weight 7.67 vs 6.00 and the coil evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustain above 30 AND fear_greed climbs above 35 AND btc_momentum_30d holds positive — transition to Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows remain pinned near 0 AND VIX spikes above 75 AND funding collapses below 30 — retest toward Anxiety
